analysis.kappa_inf: per (x, T, seed) series: least squares 1/kappa = a + b/L over ncz 24/48/96 (L = box length along z), kappa_inf = 1/a, exactly as detector.points_of
analysis.replicate_distance: per replica series: mean over the three sizes of |ln(k_rep / k_orig)|

compute: CHPC notchpeak-guest / owner-guest, 16 ranks per run, one array; grn061 untouched

decision_rule.detail: that point's original rows are forgotten from the law (archived, influence removed) and its replica series take their place; the quarantine on it is closed

valid anomaly: the rows are real dilute-limit physics the current law form (x(1-x) plus x in resistivity) cannot follow. Quarantine released (rows kept), current law scope-limited to x <= 0.90, and a basis-expansion candidate opened for the Ge-rich dilute limit
decision_rule.if: T1 passes and T2 passes and T3 passes

decision_rule.detail: the 1/L extrapolation is invalid in the Ge-rich corner (ballistic-regime method off-data, blind-catalog class M03); rows kept as lower-bound evidence, law scope-limited to x <= 0.90 with the method reason
inconclusive; recorded, next shard action designed from the result
decision_rule.if: T1 passes, T3 passes, T2 fails

deviation_policy: any change to runs, tests, or the rule after the ledger entry is a deviation with its own ledger entry before the affected run; infrastructure failures may be rerun once with the same seed and are logged

stated_before_outcomes: T1 passes (the production rows are not isolated faults)
T2 passes (kappa rises toward the Ge endpoint, as in BTE-DFT: x 0.85 -> 11.5, x 1 -> 57.1 W/mK at 300 K)
T3 is the uncertain one: C37's b/a is 40, the largest in the campaign, so the ballistic regime is plausible
predictions.status: predictions are reported pass or fail; the decision rule above is what acts

protocol: identical to the production campaign (in.mp_kappa2: Muller-Plathe rNEMD, SiCGe.tersoff, ncxy 4, swap every 50, NPT 50 ps, warm 100 ps, production 500 ps); in.mp_kappa3 adds only a final PE/atom print

tests.T1_reproduce: for BOTH C37 and C38: both replica series have replicate_distance <= 0.10 (Phase B seed scatter is 3% at ncz 24; 0.10 allows about 3 sigma)
tests.T2_gradient: at 866 K: kappa_inf(x 0.970) > kappa_inf(x 0.943, mean of original + replicas) > kappa_inf(x 0.900)
tests.T3_one_over_L: C37 seed 1038: |1/k(ncz 144) - (a + b/L144)| / (1/k(ncz 144)) <= 0.10 using a, b fitted on ncz 24/48/96 only

trigger: frozen detector, production campaign, reason 'isolated point outlier, no cause identified'
